children: narrowly beat market expectations for second-quarter core earnings on Monday, but cut its annual guidance for the metric from flat to a mid-single-digit percent decline.
The Polish firm, target of a takeover offer by a consortium led by FedEx

and Advent International, said its adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation were 1.04 billion zlotys ($277.6 million) in the quarter, while analysts polled by the company had expected 1.01 billion zlotys on average.
